# Payve

> Payve is a payments and operations platform for supply chain trade. Buyers pay every supplier from one place. Suppliers can get paid early on approved invoices and receive international payments at a competitive exchange rate. Payve agents bring organizational intelligence and automate back office workflows like orders, invoices, quality holds, and reconciliation.

Payve is a financial technology company, not a bank.

## Products

- [Payments](https://www.getpayve.com/products/payments): Pay domestic and international suppliers from one place. Domestic bank transfers; local currency to Mexico and Colombia without wire fees. Pay now or schedule payments.
- [Early pay](https://www.getpayve.com/products/early-pay): Suppliers choose to be paid early on approved invoices. They see the exact dollars received today and the fee. Buyers earn income on every election.
- [Agents](https://www.getpayve.com/products/agents): Agents connect to existing systems, answer business questions in plain English, deliver scheduled briefings, and automate order entry, document matching, complaint root-cause analysis, and notifications. A person approves every write.

## Solutions

- [Fresh produce](https://www.getpayve.com/solutions/fresh-produce): Growers, shippers, and distributors moving perishables.
- [Seafood](https://www.getpayve.com/solutions/seafood): Importers and processors with cold chain operations.
- [Packaging](https://www.getpayve.com/solutions/packaging): Packhouses and packaging suppliers to the food industry.

## Customers

- [Customer stories](https://www.getpayve.com/customers): Supply chain businesses across the US, Mexico, and Colombia run on Payve.
